parts.html: The K-12 standard model is a contemporary L-shaped kitchen in warm beige tones that combines an expressive wood texture, clean geometry, and a functional use of space. The restrained color palette and wood-effect decor create a cozy interior where modern design blends harmoniously with natural motifs.

A beige kitchen with a wood texture is well suited to apartments, condos, and private homes. Neutral tones visually lighten the furniture composition and allow it to be paired with light walls, natural stone, decorative plaster, and modern flooring.

The main feature of the K-12 model is the combination of an L-shaped layout and two types of fronts. The upper cabinets have foil-wrapped fronts, and the lower ones are made of laminated chipboard. The wood decor unites the different materials into a single composition, emphasizing the natural character of the interior.

The L-shaped layout makes efficient use of the space along two adjacent walls. This arrangement allows for a convenient organization of work surfaces, built-in appliances, and storage systems. Without a kitchen island, there is room left for a dining area and comfortable movement.
The chipboard-based countertop complements the furniture composition and provides a practical surface for everyday cooking. The kitchen carcass is made of 18 mm laminated chipboard.

For comfortable everyday use, the kitchen features Hettich hinges with soft-close mechanisms that ensure smooth door closing. The drawers run on concealed Muller runners that maintain the kitchen’s sleek aesthetic and provide easy access to storage.
The kitchen is designed for built-in appliances. Furniture handles are included with the model. Lift-up mechanisms and a cargo pull-out are not included.
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs and makes custom kitchens for apartments, condos, and private homes in Bratislava and Vienna.

The K-12 standard model can be adapted to the individual dimensions of your room, taking into account the location of utility lines and built-in appliances, as well as the client’s storage preferences.
We take a comprehensive approach to kitchen furniture: design development, selection of materials and hardware, manufacturing, delivery, and professional installation.
At the client’s request, the kitchen can also be fitted with a sink, appliances, a range hood, and plumbing fixtures.
To order the K-12 kitchen or get a personalized price quote, contact DUMSKAYA DESIGN.
